formula_note: utility = 10*recovered - 1*n_queries - 0.15*n_new_cands - 0.25*max(0,n_new-1 if not recovered else n_new) - 0.5*is_pair
selection: teacher_label = actions with utility >= 0.5 * max_utility among recovering actions; if none recover, label = empty/minimal
exhaustive_baseline_B1: all applicable single (+ optional pairs) within budget caps
model_objective: rank recovering high-utility actions above low-utility; predict sparse budget
